purpose: Ampliación de Todas las Religiones: cosmología, firmamento, mujeres del inframundo, cuatro rostros, Enoc y serpientes.

prompts.name: hielo-fuego
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 3:2 editorial artwork for a comparative mythology website. Refined painterly digital realism, midnight blue shadows and golden illumination, rich textures, consistent with illuminated ancient manuscripts and museum editorial illustrations. No text, no labels, no watermark, no logos. Clearly artistic mythological illustration. An imaginative flat-world cosmology: an oblique overhead view of a circular flat expanse of land and primordial ocean encircled by a towering unbroken wall of blue ice. Beyond one side of the disk a realm of ice and mist evokes Niflheim; far across the opposite side warm volcanic fire and embers evoke Muspell, their vapor meeting over a dark central void. The ring of ice and disk are a contemporary imaginative visual interpretation, not a scientific map or historical artifact. Dramatic luminous icy rim, expansive space, no modern landmarks.

prompts.name: firmamento
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 3:2 editorial artwork for a comparative mythology website. Refined painterly digital realism, midnight blue shadows and golden illumination, rich textures, consistent with illuminated ancient manuscripts and museum editorial illustrations. No text, no labels, no watermark, no logos. Clearly artistic mythological illustration. A beautiful ancient cosmic diagram rendered as a painterly scene: broad flat landscape and ocean beneath a vast translucent blue arched vault, luminous star-like lights embedded in the vault, deeper upper waters visibly above the dome, golden dawn along the boundary. Suggest sky being lifted away from earth with a subtle Egyptian-inspired supporting human silhouette at one side, not a modern engineering glass greenhouse. Clear distinction between earth, firmament and upper waters. Sacred cosmology, uncluttered composition.

prompts.name: reina-inframundo
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 3:2 editorial artwork for a comparative mythology website. Refined painterly digital realism, midnight blue shadows and golden illumination, rich textures, consistent with illuminated ancient manuscripts and museum editorial illustrations. No text, no labels, no watermark, no logos. Clearly artistic mythological illustration. Hel, female sovereign of the Norse underworld: a dignified adult woman sitting upright on a dark stone throne in a vast blue-gray cavern, long dark robe and sober crown, face with one side living warm skin and the other side pale shadow evoking death but no gore or exposed organs. At her feet a cold dark river and stone bridge, a black hound guarding the distant gate. Feminine authority unmistakable, solemn mythological composition, not sexualized, no Christian symbols, no invented Catholic queen.

prompts.name: cuatro-rostros
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 3:2 editorial artwork for a comparative mythology website. Refined painterly digital realism, midnight blue shadows and golden illumination, rich textures, consistent with illuminated ancient manuscripts and museum editorial illustrations. No text, no labels, no watermark, no logos. Clearly artistic mythological illustration. A respectful visual comparison in two clearly separate balanced halves, no border text: Hindu Brahma seated calmly on a lotus with four human faces looking toward four directions, use a smaller rear face in three-quarter perspective to convey the fourth; beside him the visionary four-faced living creature of Ezekiel, with distinct human, lion, ox and eagle heads and four wings. A foreground small dark velvet cloth with nine colorful precious gemstones and a thin gold ornament evokes Ezekiel 28 as a separate motif. Do not merge Brahma and the living creature into one deity. Luminous gold and deep blue, refined sacred art.

prompts.name: enoc-sol
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 3:2 editorial artwork for a comparative mythology website. Refined painterly digital realism, midnight blue shadows and golden illumination, rich textures, consistent with illuminated ancient manuscripts and museum editorial illustrations. No text, no labels, no watermark, no logos. Clearly artistic mythological illustration. A mythological editorial panorama comparing the solar journeys in Enoch and ancient Egypt. On one side an Egyptian solar boat carrying a radiant disk glides along a dark celestial river. On the other an ancient golden wheeled solar chariot carrying a luminous sun follows a gently curved celestial path toward six tall eastern gates, with six distant western gates implied across the horizon. A robed ancient observer and a luminous winged guide stand below. Wheels, curved path and gates are prominent; no literal railway tracks, no train, no modern machinery, no text.

prompts.name: serpientes-adversarias
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 3:2 editorial artwork for a comparative mythology website. Refined painterly digital realism, midnight blue shadows and golden illumination, rich textures, consistent with illuminated ancient manuscripts and museum editorial illustrations. No text, no labels, no watermark, no logos. Clearly artistic mythological illustration. Comparative mythology symbolic panorama of serpents as cosmic adversaries. Four distinct miniature scenes woven into an editorial composition: a dark serpent coiled around an Eden-like tree; a vast Egyptian Apep serpent confronting a distant golden solar boat on black water; a sea serpent rising before a Norse thunder god's hammer; and a Vedic storm deity with a lightning weapon confronting a coiled serpent obstructing mountain waters. Keep traditions visually distinct, no modern people, no real ethnic groups depicted as evil, no gore. Serious dramatic painting, readable broad shapes rather than overcrowding.
